purpose: Bounded asynchronous multi-MIME requests through the existing Iced-owned standard Wayland data-device connection. A command-only weak registry avoids a second data device or extending foreign display lifetime.
local_changes: Rich client lookup and per-request cancellation/completion
Positive selection-offer generation receipt before successful Copy/Cut
Immutable per-source MIME buffers and bounded nonblocking transfers

Omit upstream example-only target/dev-dependencies so fork unit tests run from the locked parent workspace without adding Wayland targets to every platform's workspace checks; original example and manifest retained
Rust 1.88 minimum for edition-2024 let chains; exact existing futures-channel/rustix versions; upstream foreign-display lifetime boundary retained

Default-off wayland-qa one-shot scheduling delays before write submission and after a real generation-matched compositor receipt; no injected result, serial or MIME; watchdog bounds test shutdown while the production five-second deadline continues
